name: President of Peru (Presidency of the Republic)
aliases: Presidente de la República del Perú
description: Head of state and head of government of Peru; heads the executive branch and is supreme head of the Armed Forces and National Police.

name: Cabinet of Peru (Council of Ministers)
description: Body composed of all the Ministers of State, presided by the President of the Council of Ministers (prime minister-equivalent).

key_people.title: President of the Council of Ministers
key_people.name: Luis Galarreta

name: Presidency of the Council of Ministers (PCM)
description: Government entity that coordinates the work of the ministries and supports the Council of Ministers; created December 1856.

name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
description: Peru's ministry responsible for foreign relations; one of the two original ministries created in 1821.

name: Ministry of Economy and Finance
description: Peru's ministry responsible for economic policy, public finance and the state budget; created in 1821.

name: Ministry of Justice and Human Rights
aliases: Ministerio de Justicia y Derechos Humanos
description: Peru's ministry responsible for the justice system and human rights policy.

name: Ministry of Education
description: Peru's ministry responsible for national education policy.

name: Ministry of Interior
description: Peru's ministry responsible for internal security, including the National Police of Peru.

name: Ministry of Health
description: Peru's ministry responsible for public health policy.

name: Ministry of Agricultural Development and Irrigation
aliases: Ministerio de Desarrollo Agrario y Riego
description: Peru's ministry responsible for agriculture and irrigation policy.

name: Ministry of Labour and Promotion of Employment
aliases: Ministerio de Trabajo y Promoción del Empleo
description: Peru's ministry responsible for labour policy and employment promotion.

name: Ministry of Energy and Mines
description: Peru's ministry responsible for energy and mining policy.

name: Ministry of Transport and Communications
description: Peru's ministry responsible for transport infrastructure and communications.

name: Ministry of Housing, Construction and Sanitation
aliases: Ministerio de Vivienda, Construcción y Saneamiento
description: Peru's ministry responsible for housing, construction and sanitation.

name: Ministry of Foreign Trade and Tourism
aliases: Ministerio de Comercio Exterior y Turismo
description: Peru's ministry responsible for foreign trade and tourism promotion.

name: Ministry of Women and Vulnerable Populations
aliases: Ministerio de la Mujer y Poblaciones Vulnerables
description: Peru's ministry responsible for policies on women and vulnerable populations.

name: Ministry of Environment
description: Peru's ministry responsible for environmental policy.

name: Ministry of Culture
description: Peru's ministry responsible for cultural heritage and cultural policy.

name: Ministry of Development and Social Inclusion
aliases: Ministerio de Desarrollo e Inclusión Social
description: Peru's ministry responsible for social development and inclusion programs.

name: Ministry of Production
description: Peru's ministry responsible for industry, fisheries and manufacturing policy.

name: Congress of the Republic of Peru
description: Bicameral national legislature of Peru (Senate and Chamber of Deputies); meets at the Legislative Palace in Lima.

name: Supreme Court of Peru
aliases: Corte Suprema de Justicia de la República
description: Highest judicial body in Peru, part of the Poder Judicial del Perú.

name: Constitutional Court of Peru
description: Supreme interpreter of the Peruvian Constitution; court that interprets the Constitution of Peru.

name: National Board of Justice
aliases: National Council of the Magistracy (former name)
description: Autonomous constitutional institution of Peru responsible for the selection and removal of judges and prosecutors; formerly the National Council of the Magistracy.

name: National Jury of Elections
description: Peru's electoral body that administers electoral justice, proclaims elected officials and accredits election observers.

name: National Office of Electoral Processes
description: Peruvian government agency that organizes and manages electoral processes.

name: National Registry of Identification and Civil Status
aliases: Registro Nacional de Identificación y Estado Civil
description: Autonomous Peruvian public body maintaining the national identity registry and civil status records.

name: National Superintendence of Customs and Tax Administration
aliases: Superintendencia Nacional de Aduanas y de Administración Tributaria
description: Customs and tax agency of Peru; administers national taxes and customs for the Peruvian government.

name: Superintendence of Banking, Insurance and Private Pension Fund Administrators
aliases: Superintendencia de Banca, Seguros y AFP
description: Peruvian regulator supervising the financial system, insurance companies and private pension fund administrators (AFPs).

name: Superintendence of the Securities Market
description: Peruvian regulator of the securities market, listed among the public entities of the Economy and Finance sector.

name: Comptroller General of the Republic
description: Superior audit institution of Peru, overseeing public resources and government control systems.

name: Osinergmin
aliases: Organismo Supervisor de la Energía y Minería
description: Peruvian supervisory agency for energy and mining industries.

name: Osiptel
aliases: Organismo Supervisor de Inversión Privada en Telecomunicaciones
description: Peruvian telecommunications regulator.

name: Sunass
aliases: Superintendencia Nacional de Servicios de Saneamiento
description: Peruvian national superintendence for sanitation services (water and sewerage).

name: National Institute of Statistics and Informatics
aliases: Instituto Nacional de Estadística e Informática
description: Peru's national statistics agency.

name: Ombudsman's Office of Peru
description: Autonomous constitutional organ of Peru defending constitutional rights and supervising public administration.

name: Organismo Supervisor de las Contrataciones del Estado (OSCE)
aliases: Organismo Supervisor de Contrataciones del Estado
description: Organismo público autónomo de Perú que supervisa las contrataciones del Estado (public procurement oversight).

name: PROINVERSIÓN
aliases: Agencia de Promoción de la Inversión Privada
description: Peruvian agency for the promotion of private investment.

name: National Police of Peru
description: National police force of Peru, under the Ministry of Interior.

name: Petroperú
description: Peruvian state-owned (under private law) oil company dedicated to transportation, refining, distribution and sale of fuel and other petroleum products.

name: Electroperú
aliases: Empresa de Electricidad del Perú S.A.
description: Peruvian state-owned electricity company (formed 1972) generating and commercializing power via the Mantaro hydroelectric complex; administered by FONAFE (FCR holds 85.71% of shares).

name: SEDAPAL
aliases: Servicio de Agua Potable y Alcantarillado de Lima
description: Peruvian state-owned enterprise providing drinking water and sewerage services for Lima.

name: SIMA Perú
description: Peruvian shipbuilding and naval industry state company; has an Amazon subsidiary, Sima Iquitos S.R.L.

name: FAME
aliases: Fábrica de Armas y Municiones del Ejército del Perú S.A.
description: Peruvian military factory (arms and ammunition industry).

name: Activos Mineros S.A.C.
description: Peruvian state company in charge of remediating mining environmental liabilities assigned by the State.

name: FONAFE
aliases: Fondo Nacional de Financiamiento de la Actividad Empresarial del Estado
description: National fund through which the Peruvian State administers its business-sector state-owned enterprises, including Electroperú.

name: Credicorp
description: Peruvian financial holding company; its main subsidiary Banco de Crédito del Perú (BCP) held about 36% of multiple-bank assets.

name: Alicorp
description: Peruvian consumer goods company; consolidated annual sales of S/11,764 million in 2025.

name: Backus and Johnston
aliases: Unión de Cervecerías Peruanas Backus y Johnston
description: Peruvian brewery; among the most valuable companies in Peru by market capitalization.

name: Compañía de Minas Buenaventura
description: Peruvian precious metals mining company.

name: Minsur
description: Peruvian mining company (tin and copper producer).

name: Volcan Compañía Minera
description: Peruvian mining company.

name: Nexa Resources
description: Peruvian mining company (zinc producer).

name: Cerro Verde
description: Peruvian copper mining company based in Arequipa; ranked among the most valuable companies in Peru by market cap.

name: Aenza
description: Peruvian construction and engineering corporation.

name: Claro Perú
description: Telecommunications company operating in Peru.

name: Integratel Perú
description: Peruvian telecommunications company (Telefónica operations in Peru).

name: Entel Perú
description: Peruvian subsidiary of Chilean telecommunications company Entel.

name: AJE Group
description: Multinational beverage company of Peruvian origin with about 8,000 employees.

name: Arca Continental Lindley
description: Peruvian beverage company, Coca-Cola bottler.

name: Intercorp
aliases: Intercorporación Financiera de Comercio y Industria
description: Peruvian business corporation (finance and retail sectors), based at Torre Interbank.

name: Grupo Breca
description: Peruvian business conglomerate.

name: Auna
description: Peruvian healthcare provider (hospitals and health plans).

name: Tambo+
description: Peruvian convenience store chain.

name: Real Plaza
description: Peruvian chain of shopping malls.

name: Promart Homecenter
description: Peruvian home improvement and retail chain.

name: Cencosud Perú
description: Peruvian retail company, subsidiary of Chilean retailer Cencosud.

name: Camposol
description: Peruvian agroindustrial company listed among top companies in Peru by revenue (ZoomInfo directory).

name: InRetail Peru
description: Peruvian retail and pharma holding company listed among top conglomerates in Peru (ZoomInfo directory).

name: CARE Perú
description: Peruvian humanitarian and development NGO, member of CARE International; fights poverty and social injustice with a focus on empowerment of women and girls.

name: Transparencia
description: Peruvian civil association promoting clean elections and citizen participation; accredited by the JNE as electoral observer for the 2026 general elections.

name: Instituto Prensa y Sociedad
description: Civil organization based in Lima promoting investigative journalism, freedom of expression and access to public information in Latin America; founded in Peru in 1993.

name: Confederación Campesina del Perú
description: Peruvian farmers' (peasant) movement founded in 1947.

name: Pontifical Catholic University of Peru
description: Private university in Lima, founded 1917; ranked No. 1 university in Peru in QS rankings.

name: National University of San Marcos
aliases: Universidad Nacional Mayor de San Marcos
description: Public university in Lima, Peru; ranked among the top universities of the country.

name: Cayetano Heredia University
description: Private university located in Lima, founded 1961; among Peru's top universities (health sciences focus).

name: National Agrarian University La Molina
description: Public university in Lima specialized in agrarian sciences, founded 1902.

name: University of the Pacific (Peru)
description: Private university in Lima founded 1962, focused on economics and business.

name: Peruvian University of Applied Sciences
description: Private university in Peru founded 1994; among the country's top-ranked universities.

name: ESAN University
aliases: Escuela de Administración de Negocios para Graduados
description: Peruvian graduate business school and university, founded 1963.

name: Ricardo Palma University
description: Private university in Lima founded 1969.

name: Universidad Tecnológica del Perú
description: Peruvian university founded 1997.

name: International Potato Center
description: Research institute on potato and other root and tuber crops, part of the CGIAR network, headquartered in Lima.

name: Institute of Peruvian Studies
description: Research institution in Peru founded in 1964, focused on social sciences.

name: Peruvian Institute of Nuclear Energy
description: Peruvian state research institute for nuclear energy, founded 1975, based in Lima.

name: Glaciers and Ecosystems Research National Institute
aliases: Instituto Nacional de Investigación en Glaciares y Ecosistemas de Montaña
description: Peruvian environmental research institution focused on glaciers and mountain ecosystems, founded 2014.

name: El Comercio
description: Widely known Peruvian daily newspaper and news portal; the flagship of the El Comercio Group.

name: El Comercio Group
description: Largest media conglomerate in Peru and one of the largest in South America; owns multiple newspapers and television stations; owned by the Miró Quesada family.

name: América Televisión
description: Peruvian broadcast television network.

name: Grupo RPP
description: Peruvian media conglomerate, best known for the RPP Noticias radio network and news portal.

name: Grupo ATV
description: Peruvian media conglomerate operating the ATV television network.

name: La República
description: Major Peruvian daily newspaper and news portal.

name: Andina
description: Peru's official state news agency (Agencia Peruana de Noticias).

name: Central Reserve Bank of Peru
aliases: Banco Central de Reserva del Perú
description: Central bank of Peru; autonomous constitutional institution regulating the currency and managing international reserves.

name: Banco de Crédito del Perú
description: Largest bank in Peru (main subsidiary of Credicorp), holding about 36% of multiple-bank assets.

name: Banco BBVA Perú
description: Second-largest bank in Peru (about 19.9% of multiple-bank assets), subsidiary of BBVA.

name: Interbank
description: Peruvian provider of financial services founded 1897; third-largest bank (about 13.6% of multiple-bank assets).

name: Scotiabank Perú
description: Peruvian bank, subsidiary of Bank of Nova Scotia; among the four largest banks in Peru.

name: Banco de la Nación
description: Peruvian governmental bank founded 1966; handles public treasury accounts and state financial operations.
headquarters: Torre Banco de la Nación, Lima

name: Mibanco
description: Peruvian microfinance banking company.

name: BanBif
description: Peruvian bank; fifth-largest by total assets according to rankingslatam.

name: Rímac Seguros
description: Peruvian insurance company.

name: Pacífico Seguros
description: Peruvian insurance company.

name: Andean Community
description: South American international organization (customs union of Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador and Peru) formed by the 1969 Cartagena Agreement; headquarters in Lima.

name: Fuerza Popular
description: Peruvian conservative political party founded 2010, led by Keiko Fujimori; projected to hold the most seats in the 2026 bicameral Congress.

name: American Popular Revolutionary Alliance
description: Peruvian social democratic political party founded 1924 in exile; one of Peru's historic parties.

name: Popular Action
description: Peruvian political party founded 1956; among the parties eligible for the 2026 general elections.

name: Alliance for Progress
description: Peruvian political party founded 2001 by César Acuña; took the top position on ballot papers for the 2026 regional and municipal elections.

name: Christian People's Party
description: Peruvian Christian democratic political party founded 1966; part of the Unidad Nacional electoral alliance for 2026.

name: Somos Perú
description: Peruvian Christian democratic political party founded 1997.

name: Peruvian Nationalist Party
description: Peruvian political party founded 2005 by Ollanta Humala and Nadine Heredia.

name: Renovación Popular
description: Peruvian conservative political party; projected among the parties with the most seats in the 2026 Congress.

name: Avanza País
aliases: Go On Country - Social Integration Party
description: Peruvian political party (Avanza País - Partido de Integración Social) among those eligible for the 2026 general elections.

name: Juntos por el Perú
description: Peruvian left-wing political coalition/party; projected among the parties with the most seats in the 2026 Congress.

name: Peruvian Armed Forces
description: Military services of Peru, comprising independent Army, Navy and Air Force components under the Ministry of Defence.

name: Joint Command of the Armed Forces of Peru
aliases: Comando Conjunto de las Fuerzas Armadas del Perú
description: Military body responsible for planning, preparation, coordination and direction of the Peruvian military's operations; depends directly on the President of the Republic.

name: Peruvian Army
description: Land warfare branch of Peru's armed forces.

name: Peruvian Navy
description: Naval branch of the Peruvian Armed Forces; includes naval infantry and the General Directorate of Captaincies and Coast Guards (DICAPI).

name: Peruvian Air Force
description: Air warfare branch of Peru's military.
